citation.authors: Figueiredo AS, Braz GL, Garcia FF, Moreno LB et al
citation.journal: Medicina Oral, Patologia Oral y Cirugia Bucal

record.population: 7 reported cases of pigmented contact cheilitis (6 women, mean age 32)
record.finding: Ricinoleic acid and gum ester were the most frequent allergens, each in two cases. All cases had multiple pigmented lesions, with itching, scaling, swelling, redness, vesicles or papules, and a mean duration of 13.5 months. The authors say it often alarms patients because of the unexpected darkening.
record.note: Seven case reports; shows that an allergy to a lip product can darken lips; not a measure of how common it is.
